system.description:
Wit; 1 Pierce; Close (5 ft). Deployable, Trap and Trapped, as for the Bear Trap: an enemy moving toward its hex must pass a CR 2 Wit Check to go around, or it stumbles in and takes the damage. A caught Large or smaller enemy can't Move until it passes a CR 2 Grit Check, and it takes 1 wound breaking free.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.147

when.label: Trap: a Large or smaller enemy moves toward it

automation.note: Deployable and Trap: place the snare on a hex. When an enemy moves toward it, target the enemy and click the snare's button on its chat card. The enemy rolls a CR 2 Wit Check, and if it fails it is Immobile (Trapped). There is no Strike roll, so apply the 1 Pierce by hand on a failure. For an enemy bigger than Large, roll its Wit Check by hand: it takes the damage on a failure but isn't Trapped. A Trapped enemy stays put until it passes a CR 2 Grit Check, then removes Immobile and takes 1 wound.
